notes.title: Fishy fart has been fixed!
notes.notes: Sorry for the bug in Fart ability. Now it has been fixed. You can now smooooooothly fart in the direction you want again. :)

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.3
notes.notes:
- Fix music bug after beat some boss.
- Fix "heal after kill boss" perk sometime not activate.
- Fix extra life drained if player go out of bound with extremely high bounce rate.
- Fix some trophies calculation.
- Fix strange player movement at high bounce rate.
- Improve gameplay performance.
- Increase bomb countdown time.
